change: For local-vLLM requests only, use a 360-second client timeout and allow at most four actually dispatched attempts. Check the cap before creating the next ledger attempt. Accept the first successful response without outcome-based selection. Paid requests remain non-retryable with their unchanged 90-second timeout.
rationale: The same deterministic local extraction request reached the 180-second client boundary three times without returning a semantic response. Extending only the transport wait window permits the frozen request to finish; it does not alter the model computation requested or select among completed outputs.
unchanged: extractor/controller/QA prompts, models, temperatures, schemas, and token budgets
immutable USER fragments and extraction acceptance rules
controller results and paid no-retry protocol
